checks.title: Unit tests of the tools
reuse lint (SPDX licence and copyright on every file)
Commit messages follow .gitmessage
Low profile: name, description, topics, README
No secrets in tracked files
No private terms in tracked files or commit messages
No toolchain parts or binaries tracked
Claude Code deny lists never drop an entry
Archived session transcripts: banners and forbidden material
No emulator-only identifiers outside the spec side's folders
docs/HARDWARE-SPEC.md: every entry has an ID, fact, sources, standing; no code; IDs kept
A fresh clean folder has no spec-side files and denies them
tools/fwtest runs an image pinned by digest
Vendored SDK files match the pinned commit
Vendored Plaits files match the pinned upstream commits
Vendored emulator crates match the pinned upstream commit
Build container (pinned base, toolchain SHA-256 checked)
Build A in a fresh container (source at /mnt/small-beeps-src)
Build B in a fresh container (source at another path)
Builds A and B are byte-identical
Firmware image size (code, data, bss) from build A

Firmware in fwtest: boot, clock, tick and heartbeat timing, vector table, idle, fault and stray reports, the screen, the panel's keys, encoders, pot and LEDs, the audio output and the test instrument (tests/fw/boot.suite)
The preset bank in fwtest: each preset's reference note (clipping, DC, clicks, loudness, its category's shape), 16 voices, golden SHA-256 (tools/preset_suite.py)
The arpeggiator in fwtest: each mode and rate against its model, the frames of its steps, MIDI clock in and out, MIDI out, no stuck notes, its screen, saving, under load (tools/arp_suite.py)

The firmware as a .fwsc: packed from build A's package link, it boots in fwtest's package path as the raw image does in the suite's main cases, and fwtest refuses each broken package at the reader's check (tools/package_suite.py)

Seams for firmwares built on small-beeps: the build's write-back store check, outside sources, per-folder flags, the engine seam, the platform alone, core 1's start, the runtime, the SysEx tap, raw MIDI out, the store's firmware kinds, saves cut by a power cut (tools/seams_suite.py)
The app release from build A, made twice: byte for byte the same; release.json format 1.0; the .fm1img passes the app's checks in order (tools/release.py selftest)
Firmware size, RAM, stack high-water and instructions per period, within budget and the 3% speed gate
Deliberately slower and bigger builds fail the performance gates; a known stack use shows
The Plaits load test: demo builds, soft-float exact, every engine measured, clean audio
The harness uses no stock-boot path (packages only through the package reader)
Harness test images rebuild identically with the pinned toolchain
fwtest container (pinned bases, offline build)
The fwtest container rebuilds to the same image ID (from scratch, later, from a context with other file times and owners)
The harness's own tests (cargo test in the container)
fwtest runs every instruction form the pinned toolchain knows for the firmware's CPU flags, or the form is a documented gap (harness/isa/known-gaps.txt)
Harness suite, run A (fresh container, tests at /mnt/harness-a)
Harness suite, run B (fresh container, tests at another path)
Harness suite runs A and B are byte-identical
Spec-side experiments rebuild identically and give the results the spec cites
Signed owner merge of a pull request that passed CI
No private terms in the record's own files (any that hold one are withheld, named with their SHA-256)
